title: Figs. 14-15: Gemini S-5 Synoptic Terrain and S-6 Synoptic Weather Photography boards
description: Two experiment display boards, each with an orbital photograph and fields for purpose, equipment (70 mm camera and film), weight, procedure and location (pressurized cabin). Fig. 14 shows a terrain photo captioned as the Himalayas in the India, Nepal, Tibet border area taken by astronaut L. Gordon Cooper, Jr. during his 22-orbit MA-9 mission; Fig. 15 shows clouds and the Burma west coast west of Rangoon, also taken by Cooper on MA-9. Text in NASA document M-913-65-04 says these are similar to the photographs planned for GT-4.
